title: Transfiguration of Christ
definition: The transfiguration of Christ is the event where Jesus' divine glory was visibly displayed before selected disciples.
summary: The transfiguration reveals the glory, authority, and divine identity of Jesus.
christFocus: Christ's transfiguration gives a preview of His glory and confirms that He is the beloved Son to be heard.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
At the transfiguration, Jesus' glory shone before Peter, James, and John. Moses and Elijah appeared, and the Father's voice declared Jesus to be His beloved Son.

This event reveals Christ's majesty and confirms His superiority. The disciples are commanded to listen to Him.

The transfiguration also strengthens hope. The suffering path of the cross does not cancel Christ's glory; it leads to resurrection and exaltation.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People may see only the humility of Jesus and miss His majesty. The transfiguration matters because it reveals the glory of the Son who must be heard and worshiped.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Listen to Christ above every other voice. Let His glory strengthen your faith when following Him includes suffering.
